description: Frozen architecture experiment configuration for the original-question closure (v1). Six arms per scenario, all enforced through the canonical Java runtime contract path. Fresh Dirichlet(0.1) workloads under the confirmed heterogeneity scenario and capacity construction, exact pending-queue declarations, unit floors, two contention levels, 200 fresh confirmatory seeds per contention cell from a new deterministic namespace with no overlap with canonical, pilot, heterogeneity-confirmatory, comparator-development, or distributed-validation seeds. The same scenario is paired across arms within a seed; the same workload is paired across contention within a seed. Queue-order completion is primary; exact best-subset completion (direct enumeration of all 256 subsets) is a robustness outcome. This configuration is preregistered and must not be edited after any confirmatory seed or outcome is generated.
five_condition_rule: For a treatment-minus-base comparison in a contention cell, using queue-order completion: (1) treatment mean completion higher than base; (2) paired 95% percentile bootstrap interval for treatment minus base strictly above zero; (3) point estimate at least +1.000 completed task per 48-task run; (4) treatment does not increase the observed zero-completion fraction relative to base; (5) both arms have zero infeasibility, fallback, capacity, and bound violations.

fresh_replication.requires: both cells pass the five-condition rule

coordination_test.requires: both cells pass the five-condition rule AND fresh_replication passes AND the comparator audit establishes independent_bundle_maxmin distinct from DRF

independent_vs_drf.requires: both cells pass the five-condition rule
